title: EnvVault Data
description: Root structure of the encrypted vault database. The UI reads this file to populate form tooltips. Field names match data-field attributes on form labels in index.html.

provider.description: Name of the service, platform, or system (e.g. GitHub, Stripe, DATABASE_URL).

account_name.description: Username, handle, or email for the account this credential belongs to.

api_key.description: Primary secret value — API key, bearer token, password, env var value, private key, etc.

api_secret.description: Secondary secret that pairs with the primary key (e.g. client secret, shared secret, HMAC key).

key_id.description: Label used to disambiguate multiple keys from the same provider (e.g. 'stripe_test' vs 'stripe_live'). Also used as the env-var name suffix.

api_description.description: Short technical description of what this credential does. Shown on the card by default.

description.description: Longer personal context — which project uses this credential, caveats, notes.

details.description: Extra metadata, connection strings, usage notes, or anything that doesn't fit other fields.

secretType.description: Kind of secret. Controls which form fields are shown and how the card renders. api_key: standard API key / token. password: username + password login. certificate: TLS/SSL cert (PEM). env_var: environment variable. connection_string: DB/service URL. ssh_key: SSH keypair. file_blob: arbitrary file reference.

price_type.description: Pricing model for the associated service. free = free tier; local = self-hosted; paid = active subscription; conditional = invite/membership/ratio-based.

environment.description: Deployment environment this credential is scoped to. Shown as a coloured dot on the card.

categories.description: Flat tag names (UI label: Projects). Must match entries in user_categories. Used for quick filtering in the sidebar.

projectIds.description: Hierarchical project IDs (UI label: Categories) this entry belongs to. Always contains 'Universal'. IDs match Project.id in the projects array.

api_url.description: Base URL of the service API (e.g. https://api.github.com). Shown as a clickable link on the card.

callback_url.description: OAuth redirect URI or webhook callback URL registered with the provider.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD). Triggers a warning badge when approaching or past this date.

last_rotated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last manual rotation. Set automatically when 'Mark as rotated' is used.

scopes.description: OAuth permission scopes or capability strings granted to this credential (e.g. ["repo", "read:user"]).

rate_limit.description: Human-readable rate limit description (e.g. '1000 req/hr', '60 req/min per IP').

version.description: API or SDK version this credential was issued for (e.g. 'v3', '2024-01-01').

custom_icon.description: Simple Icons slug to use as the provider icon (e.g. 'github', 'stripe'). Overrides the auto-detected icon.

username.description: Username or login name. Used by password and ssh_key secret types.

email.description: Email address associated with this credential.

certificate_data.description: PEM-encoded certificate (-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----). Used by the certificate secret type.

cert_key_data.description: PEM-encoded private key paired with certificate_data (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----).

blob_ref.description: File-system path or reference identifier for a file_blob credential.

env_var_subtype.description: Display hint for env_var entries that controls validation and rendering.

version_history.description: Snapshots of previous api_key values. Prepended automatically on each save when the primary value changes. Capped at 50 entries.

saved_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this value was superseded.

user_categories.description: Ordered list of flat project tag names (UI label: Projects). All values in api_keys[].categories must be present here.

projects.description: Hierarchical project nodes (UI label: Categories). Always contains at least the Universal catch-all entry. Slash-delimited names encode a virtual tree: 'Cloud/AWS' is a child of 'Cloud'.

id.description: Stable, URL-safe, lowercase identifier derived from name. 'Universal' is the reserved catch-all.

name.description: Display name. Slash-segments encode virtual hierarchy (e.g. 'Cloud/AWS').

description.description: Optional tooltip shown in the category tree sidebar.

project_type.description: High-level type of the project. Drives the structured config view (WireGuard peers, Docker Compose, Nginx blocks, K8s manifests, etc.).

chunks.description: Structured config sections for non-generic projects. Each chunk maps to a named section (WireGuard [Interface]/[Peer], Docker service, Nginx server block, K8s Deployment, etc.).

chunk_type.description: Determines field schema and export format.

fields.description: Ordered list of key-value config fields in this chunk.

value.description: Raw value or '${REF_NAME}' to reference a vault env_var entry.

field_type.description: How this field is categorised and exported.

ref_name.description: If set, value is resolved from the vault entry where provider === ref_name and secretType === 'env_var'.

secret.description: When true the value is masked in the UI.

default.name: Universal
default.description: All secrets belong here by default.
